notes: All six pages are single-person Purdue Krannert "Distinguished PhD Alum" profile pages captured by Common Crawl (crawls CC-MAIN-2013-20, 2013-48 and 2014-49). Each snapshot directory holds three text captures (a 2013-06 capture in addition to the two listed in chunk-38.json texts); all three were read and recorded per the brief's "every text file" rule, so each person has three rows. Each page states only the alum's name, a current title and institution: no graduation year, degree year, department, advisor or dissertation. The "PhD" degree is taken from the page heading "Distinguished PhD Alum". The listed affiliation is the current post at capture time and must not be treated as a first placement. The recurring sidebar lists "Graduate profiles 2013 ... / 2012 ..." (Brendan Bonner through Byron Young) are navigation links to Krannert master's graduate profiles, not doctoral graduates, and were skipped. The chunk URL for horsky/koehler/servaes uses www.krannert.purdue.edu while some captures were of krannert.purdue.edu; the sourceUrl recorded is each capture's own Common Crawl index lookup. None of these six alumni is identified by the page as an operations graduate (titles are in marketing, finance/corporate governance and MIS).
